Verification: 133 browser tests passed (67 web, 66 mobile regression), plus 3 sizing-policy tests. Both TypeScript checks, lint, PHP/API gates and the production build passed.
Integration boundary: browser API responses are mocked for these reviews. The route planner rejects incomplete responses; the existing backend route response still needs alignment with the detailed route contract before real route rendering can be certified. No route is fabricated. Read web-visual-redesign.md for scope, references and limitations.
